android.desc:
Hidden Settings helps you discover and access advanced Android settings, system menus, and device information that may be difficult to find through your phone's standard interface.

Designed for Android enthusiasts, developers, and power users, Hidden Settings provides a clean and organized way to access useful system tools from one place.

⚡ QUICK SYSTEM ACCESS

Quickly access device tools, developer options, battery settings, display controls, diagnostics, and manufacturer-specific settings. Optimized for Samsung One UI, Xiaomi HyperOS / MIUI, Google Pixel UI, OnePlus OxygenOS, Motorola MyUX, Sony Xperia, Huawei EMUI, Honor MagicOS, ASUS ZenUI, Nothing OS, Realme UI, Oppo ColorOS, Vivo Funtouch OS, Tecno HiOS, Infinix XOS, and more.

🚀 FEATURES

• Activity Launcher: Open available Android settings screens and activity pages quickly.

• Network & Connectivity: Access Private DNS settings, Wi-Fi calling related settings (where supported by your device and carrier), and other network configuration tools.

• App Manager: View and manage installed applications, active apps, battery optimization settings, and default app behaviors.

• Advanced Search: Find settings, applications, activity pages, and packages instantly.

• Custom Shortcuts & Widgets: Create home screen shortcuts and widgets for frequently used settings and system information.

• Notification History: Access your device's notification history and logs when supported by Android.

• AI Assistant: Learn more about system activities and settings with AI-powered explanations.

• Advanced Features: Optional Root or Shizuku integration is available for supported actions on compatible devices.

Find settings faster. Personalize your workflow. Access advanced Android tools from one convenient place.

⚠️ Note: Available settings, activity pages, and features depend on your device manufacturer, Android version, available permissions, and system support. Some functions may not be available on all devices.

Hidden Settings is an independent utility and is not affiliated with Android, Google, Samsung, Xiaomi, or any device manufacturer.
